 News & Highlights
	
	
 

 
	

	
	
	

 
 

	
 

	
 
 
 
 
 No Wake Zone Maps 
	
	
When on the water in Orange Beach, please help keep everyone safe by knowing and abiding by the wake zone rules. Find No Wake Zones about No Wake Zone Maps 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 Stay Connected! 
	
	
Subscribe to Notify Me to receive updates and information about community news and happenings. Check Out Notify Me!
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Resident beach pass information 
	
	
Each year, residents need to reactivate Resident Beach Access at CoastAL parking passes and get 2026 parking decals for Gulf State Park beach accesses; proof of residency required Read on... about Resident beach pass information 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Spring break notice, small section of Alabama Point beach temporarily closed 
	
	
Annual family-friendly destination reminder by City and notice of small beach closure under the Perdido Pass bridge Read on... about Spring break notice, small section of Alabama Point beach temporarily closed 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 ALDOT continues progress on Intracoastal Waterway Bridge, SR-161 Connector 
	
	
In addition, ALDOT will widen a portion of SR-180 from Beaver Creek to the current toll-free Beach Express Bridge. All projects remain on schedule for completion by summer 2026. Read on... about ALDOT continues progress on Intracoastal Waterway Bridge, SR-161 Connector 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Pensacola and Perdido Bays Estuary Program awarded grant 
	
	
$750,000 in funds to establish regional Water Quality Monitoring Collaborative, which includes Orange Beach Read on... about Pensacola and Perdido Bays Estuary Program awarded grant 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Orange Beach Wildlife Center spreads its wings at new facility 
	
	
New state-of-the-art facility unveiled with ribbon-cutting ceremony on Jan. 6th Read on... about Orange Beach Wildlife Center spreads its wings at new facility 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Police, fire award winners announced 
	
	
Lt. Zachary Cook named 2025 Firefighter of the Year; Lt. Lisa Augustin, 2025 Officer of the Year; and police IT Administrator Stephen Centrone, 2025 Employee of the Year Read on... about Police, fire award winners announced 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Orange Beach City Schools achieves No. 2 Report Card Score in Alabama 
	
	
Score is second-highest among all 149 traditional and charter school systems in the state, an extraordinary achievement accomplished in just three years since the district’s formation on July 1, 2022 Read on... about Orange Beach City Schools achieves No. 2 Report Card Score in Alabama 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Orange Beach City Schools Rises to the State’s Elite with Score of 98 
	
	
OBES improved its report card score to a 99, up two points from last year, and OBMHS also improved to a 95, up from last year’s 94, while earning 100% of possible points in graduation rate. Read on... about Orange Beach City Schools Rises to the State’s Elite with Score of 98 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Orange Beach City Schools ranks No. 2 in Alabama proficiency rankings 
	
	
Rankings include No. 1 in Science, No. 2 in Math, No. 4 in English Language Arts; No. 2 Overall; ACAP and ACT - Most Improved Proficiency Scores in the State Read on... about Orange Beach City Schools ranks No. 2 in Alabama proficiency rankings 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Historic groundbreaking ceremony held for Orange Beach City Schools Athletic Complex 
	
	
The young Orange Beach City School System celebrated a generational step forward on Tuesday, Nov. 7, 2023 with the groundbreaking ceremony for a state-of-the-art athletic complex. Read on... about Historic groundbreaking ceremony held for Orange Beach City Schools Athletic Complex 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Welcome to Our New Website 
	
	
The City of Orange Beach is excited to announce the launch of a newly redesigned city website. With the MyAccount and Notify Me features, residents and visitors can customize their viewing experience and stay up-to-date on city events. Learn more about the new website
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Visitor Information 
	
	
We have some of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Learn more about our area from our partners at Orange Beach & Gulf Shores Tourism. Explore Orange Beach
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 No Wake Zone Maps 
	
	
When on the water in Orange Beach, please help keep everyone safe by knowing and abiding by the wake zone rules. Find No Wake Zones about No Wake Zone Maps 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Stay Connected! 
	
	
Subscribe to Notify Me to receive updates and information about community news and happenings. Check Out Notify Me!
	

 
 

 
 
 
 
 Resident beach pass information 
	
	
Each year, residents need to reactivate Resident Beach Access at CoastAL parking passes and get 2026 parking decals for Gulf State Park beach accesses; proof of residency required Read on... about Resident beach pass information 
	

 
 
 
 
 
 Spring break notice, small section of Alabama Point beach temporarily closed 
	
	
Annual family-friendly destination reminder by City and notice of small beach closure under the Perdido Pass bridge Read on... about Spring break notice, small section of Alabama Point beach temporarily closed

	It is a pleasure to welcome you to the City of Orange Beach, Alabama website. You can find information about each department within our city and appropriate contact information for each area. City services and programs continue to grow as we provide our residents and visitors with a superb quality of life and enjoyable place to live, work and visit. The dedication of our entire city staff and support of residents makes the development of this community an ongoing process. I hope that you find this website to be a useful and informative source of information about our fine city. Sincerely, Tony Kennon Mayor of the City of Orange Beach
